scope: 完整3505件固定validation，原SVR与DPO step5000，单图单次c00，无候选选优；仅在run complete后统计。

execution.elapsed_scope: This run reuses 100 objects per method; elapsed_seconds covers new work and aggregation, not the earlier reused execution.

protocol.comparison: original SVR vs final DPO step 5000; no checkpoint selection
protocol.post_aggregation: mean of three repeats within each CAD, then mean across CADs
protocol.cd: symmetric squared Chamfer; no square root
protocol.bootstrap: paired CAD resampling; percentile 95% interval; 10000 samples; seed 42
protocol.validity_bootstrap: valid=1; invalid/unknown=0; unknown counts reported separately

interpretation_limits: All Chamfer quantities are normalized-coordinate squared distances, not physical units.
Post own means use different successful measurable populations; only paired_common compares the same identities.
DPO-only complete measurements do not all mean newly valid models; transition counts explicitly distinguish measurement completion from validity changes.
More or fewer B-Rep faces can reflect partitioning differences and do not by themselves establish missing geometry or hidden-geometry correctness.
The association between lower predicted face counts and higher validity is not a causal attribution.
Missing triangulation / nonpositive sampled mesh area occurs after recorded native validity. These are metric-computation failures, not relabeled CAD-invalid cases.
The observed ValueError/transfer errors do not establish a PythonOCC API incompatibility or a specific implementation bug. No original evaluation was changed or rerun.
Paired bootstrap resamples CAD identities with the existing one-sample seeds; it does not measure variation across sampling seeds.
Per-candidate timings include reused records and concurrent hardware contention; they are descriptive costs, not an isolated throughput benchmark.
